item.title: OEM backed EV charging networks lift satisfaction
item.summary: Public EV charging in the US is becoming more reliable as newer OEM backed networks improve the experience for electric vehicle drivers. The latest JD Power study shows satisfaction with DC fast charging rising, while failed charging visits have fallen to the lowest level recorded by the research.
